text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Duramente displays an overwhelming run. 
Yet once again, she's getting too worked 
up...! "Duramente!!" desperately calling 
out her name.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Holding herself back just on the brink of 
losing control, Duramente showed off her 
incredible strength. However... she fell 
just one step short of victory.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
After the race, she said that your voice 
had definitely reached her. Surely it was 
because... you believed in her. From the 
bottom of her heart, she thanked you for 
believing in her.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
However, her drive for improvement was not 
satisfied. She was determined to mature 
mentally and win the Nippon Derby with a 
flawless performance.
